company_info.company_description: "Energy Solution Centre has multiple accreditations specialising in residential solar, commercial solar and off-grid solutions. As well as delivering premium value, the customer experience is at the heart of everything we do. We also don’t believe in ‘one-size-fits-all'.We will assist you in achieving the outcome you truly desire, saving you from paying overpriced energy bills and giving you absolute peace of mind. Large solar arrays and small solar systems, on and off-grid, our Gold Coast solar team will tailor-make an energy solution for you. Here at ESC, we have all the leading brands in solar power, solar battery, energy storage, off-grid solutions and EV charging."

reviews.review_description: There’s a lot of cowboys in the solar installation rodeo, but there is also a lot of amateurs that get bucked off because they don’t have what it takes to make it…Not this crowd! What an amazing team, right from the sales team when I walked into the showroom, through to the final installation. A big thank you to Keith for his patience and explanations of various system’s costings, limitations and benefits etc. Also met several other team members that were friendly, warm, attentive and courteous.Have to mention the showroom, awesome to be able to see all the products without having to rely on just brochures and a website only, really adds to the experience.Communication was fantastic and the quality and patience of advice and answers (I had a lot of questions) were both comprehensive and informative, which was important with such an investment.It goes without saying, but they took care of ALL the applications and paperwork with the government rebate and Energex. A very simple process for myself.I ended up going with a Sigenergy 10kw inverter and a 40kw battery setup with extra panels on the roof to add to my existing panels.The quality of the install was also fantastic, not a scrap of dust or insulation left over, just an amazing new installation.They were actually able to bring my installation forward 8 days earlier due to a cancellation, even though the sun was well up in the morning sky, and hot, they still managed to get the install finished before I got home AND the battery was just under half full. First night of install with zero energy from the grid. Super happy about that.Installers were all friendly and professional which reflected in their workmanship. Great communication from Adam and Jacob with a few last minute changes for an upgraded switchboard and battery additions, very glad they are on the ball. They have done it ALL properly the first time and ultimately saved me time and money in the process. They also noticed a slight bit of sag in my old roof where the panels were going to be fitted and did an amazing job of still managing to make it look great.Had the honour of meeting the owner Lucio too, it’s no wonder the team are fantastic as he definitely leads by example. Even though obviously busy, he still made the time to thank me for the business and to share my positive feelings about his team, of which he’s openly proud of.I am looking forward to fully utilising my new Sigenergy system and already obsessed with the app and its functionality. Next stop, energy trading.Also looking forward to my first credit invoice from an energy company in 5 years, even with my existing solar.Thanks team, absolutely zero hesitation in using them for anything extra in the future and more than happy to recommend to future clients.Spinal Tap would be proud because your business went to 11 out of 10.

The ESC team and particularly Keith Butler who was our Solar and Battery Design Consultant were exceptionally efficient and Professional to deal with.After much discussion with Keith we decided to take full advantage of the Battery Rebate offer and managed to fit another 9 KW on our roof.We are exceptionally happy we chose the Energy Solution Centre. They offer a very personalised service and really make special efforts to do the installation well.

We recently had installed a12kw solar system with Aiko Neostar panels & Sigen Controler & Gateway with 3x 8kw (24kw) batteries from Energy Solution Centre Nerang.We got many quotes from other solar companies. But the problem we had was we had a complicated hip roof divided into 3 levels to work with... Which was seen as a big problem with most companies.But not for Keith Butler he was our go to guy... he was informative, pleasent & showed us everything on a huge wall mounted computer screen. Which brought up your house on screen & showed you what was possible to attain on your roof visually.The installation was completed in one day & the next day we we off grid... The system is amazing... No more power bills... & in credit with power company... Not bad for spring weather... Thanks Keith & Energy Solution Centre... You guys are great...

Great local team that provided all the information we needed when we needed it. Great communication from sales to install to follow up check ins. Our Sigenergy system is running beautifully and looks great too. Comforting to know we have local business we can easily reach out to for any future needs.

I compared 11 proposals from 7 suppliers and chose Energy Solutions Centre.Excellent showroom and face-to-face service; punctual, knowledgeable team; very competitive price.Neat install finished in just over half a day and exporting to the grid the same day.Customer Service was great, and the grid connection organised by them prior to install.I thoroughly recommend the Energy Solutions Centre and I will use them for any future related requirements.

Energy Solution Centre have been excellent to deal with. Keith our salesman was very easy to talk to & provided easy to understand information about  solar & battery systems. He was very knowledgeable regarding our current system, the government rebate & what was needed to upgrade to battery storage. He also visited our home to check how the system was to be installedWe decided on the Sigen 32kw battery system & 10 extra panels.  Install was delayed for a  month due to the high demand on the wholesalers, Jacob the installation manager kept us in the loop.Installation went without any problems & the team  were very professional & knowledgeable. Keith called us that evening to make sure we are happy & popped in the next day to check all was ok.We couldn’t be happier & highly recommend Energy Solution Centre for their excellent customer service & pricing.

Superb. I cannot praise Keith and the team highly enough. This is the only supplier that I would go with. This is a reputable business. They both SUPPLY the products (and only use high quality products) and complete the INSTALLATION (no dodgy subcontractors). The advice and follow up service is awesome. I've recommended them to others - best on the GC!

I recently had some additional PV solar panels and a SigenStor 32kWh battery installed by Energy Solution Centre.The team at ESC were very engaging (a significant difference from the other retailers I considered) and took the time to understand our requirements and explain the key factors that ultimately influenced our decision. I recommend a visit to the showroom. Particular thanks to Lucio, Sean and Jacob. Additionally, the installation team (led by Millar) were communicative, friendly, and efficient.SigenStor seems to be the outstanding option for a home battery, with superior design and features. I'm very happy with the hardware and the mySigen app. The battery is compact and looks good installed in the garage ready for future use as an electric vehicle charger.I have since switched my energy supplier to Amber which gives me access to wholesale energy prices (for buying and selling). I'm less than one month in with Amber and generate a modest net credit each day by selling power to the grid. It's currently winter so yet to see how successful Amber will be over a full year.The house now runs on 100% renewable energy, and I choose to sell renewable energy to the grid at critical times of day when renewables are scarce.

Guys at Energy Solution did a fantastic job on my system and am very happy with its performance. Sean managed to upsell me from Goodwe batteries to the Sigenergy system and I'm so glad he did. The system is awesome and I have so much control over charging and discharging. I'm now ready to look for an Electric Vehicle and charger to add to the home. Highly recommend the guys at Energy Solution Centre, big thumbs up.

Well, after receiving 4 quotes from different solar installers...they were all different prices ,systems, ect and could not have been more different from each others!!! and we were asking the same thing..We already had a 13.2 kW solar system on the roof but only facing East and North!! We were missing all the West sun and also had some spare space on the roof facing North and a 10kW Inverter (not hybrid) and we wanted some batteries (after a whole week with no power after the Cyclone).....So I decided to check out my local one! Energy solution center in Nerang, Gold Coast,QLD. After reviewing their Google reviews , ABN and history...I met with Sean at their office where they have lots of different Brand, batteries, solar panels, ect..ect...in their show room! (that was pretty cool and was the only one who had a show room)Sean understood what I wanted and was trying to achieve.....adding a new solar system and battery to the already existing one!. The 1st quote was ....a shock!! so we chat again and after telling him my budget...we both work on what exactly I wanted and where I wanted it!! the 2 nd quote was still too much but by the 3 rd time we received a quote that tailored our need!(slightly out of our budget)We went for the Sigenergy system....12.80kW solar system (26 panels) + a 20kW Hybrid inverter + 24 kWh battery (3X8kWh) + Sigen Gateway 3 phase.the install took 1 1/2 day...the job was done neatly and crew were nice...our Electrian Ian was very professional and helpful and answer all my questions without a problem.The App is absolutely fantastic...definitly the best one one the market....tells you everything you need to know and what s happening in real time!Waiting patiently for the 1st of July to be able to use the batteries. In total we have now a 26kW solar system with 59 solar panels....and not expecting an electricity bill at all....basicly nearly "off Grid"Energy Solution Center is definitly the one to go to on the Gold Coast...

I recently had the ESC team install solar panels and batteries at my home, and I couldn't be happier with the experience! From start to finish, the team was incredibly professional, informative, and friendly. They took the time to explain the process and answer all my questions, making me feel confident in my decision. What impressed me the most was how they cleaned up after themselves, leaving my property spotless. Overall, a fantastic experience—highly recommend ESC for anyone considering solar installation! It’s a 5 start from me!!

I recently had a 13.2 kW AIKO solar panel system installed with a SIGENERGY 10 kW inverter and 2x 8 kW SIGENERGY batteries from Energy Solution Centre, and I’m extremely satisfied with the whole experience. The team was incredibly knowledgeable and guided me through every step, ensuring I understood how the system would work and the benefits it would bring.What impressed me even more was how they ensured that my current generator setup was compatible and working properly with the new system. The installation was quick and efficient, with the technicians showing great care throughout the process. Having the battery backup gives me peace of mind during outages. I highly recommend Energy Solution Centre for anyone looking to invest in a solar system; their professionalism and quality of service are outstanding!

One of the things we really appreciated about the Energy Solution Centre is Lucio's genuine passion for educating people about solar.We were presented a couple of options that enabled us to balance our needs with our budget with a view to expanding storage later on.The install crew were punctual, courteous and respectful. We appreciated Lucio's phone call post install to check how everything went and to talk us through what we were seeing in the app.Very happy with the customer service and product at a very competitive price.
Sean was fantastic and found the solution for me which others could not
Keith from Energy Solution Centre was awesome to deal with. He got straight back to me with my many questions and tried to arrange the install of our battery system with very little notice.

Keith from Energy Solution Centre (ESC) was very knowledgeable and patient in providing options and answering questions about a new solar system for us.  We were replacing an existing solar system on the roof which was many years old and not working as it should.  He explained how the new system would work and provided several different options in size for our needs. He was also very patient in responding to changing quote requests as our understanding increased. An install date was arranged very quickly and Nathan came out and did the install with a minimum of fuss or inconvenience to us. Would highly recommend this company. Very professional.

The company name says it all - "The Energy Solution Centre" (ESC).After 4 years of a solar only operation we decided to look at upgrading to include a battery storage solution.Keith and the guys at The Energy Solution Centre were fantastic.Keith patiently and clearly took us through the options, pointing out the Pros and Cons along the way.He explained the differences between AC & DC coupled systems, he presented minimum cost solutions as knowingly as the top end big name options. Then came whether we wanted a simple "backup" solution or a true "no break UPS" operation. It was a real eye opener at all the possibilities and considerations.We were also able to see examples of most of the units in their wonderful showroom which simply added a whole new level of understanding and confidence in their suggestions and potential solutions. There wasn't any pressure to go any particular path, just options that we could consider and the cost of each one.All the options of interest were then added to their amazing online proposal system which we could then look at when we got home. I had never seen anything like it. Whenever a change was requested or another option was thought about, it was instantly available for us with pricing to review from home, whether we asked about it in person or over the phone. It was all a great experience.Our original system had been a Fronius inverter and we had been extremely happy with its performance, so our plan was to simply add the Fronius battery upgrade to it. However, after the day with Keith (and much online searching over a couple of days), the winning option was a new player in the field "SigEnergy" which though VERY new to market, Energy Solution Centre had already had some experience with. It ticked ALL the boxes with options like batteries from 5kWh to 48kWh, full "No Break UPS" to the whole house, future expansion for Vehicle to Home (V2H).(Approved in South Australia but soon to the rest of OZ.),and a neat single stack installation at a very competitive price.Having decided on the system, Keith arranged everything.!! The system was installed and operating within a week.Frankly I was staggered.!!The installation crew arrived at the appointed time and didn't muck around. They were friendly and clearly highly competent. They discussed all the placement options with us carefully taking aesthetics and future expansion into account. The final product being a very neat and highly professional job.All the waste down to scraps of insulation from the wires and the dust from the drilling were cleaned up with only footprints in the grass (and the system) being the only things left behind.All in all an extremely positive experience and I would have absolutely no hesitation recommending "The Energy Solution Centre" to anyone thinking about going Solar in Brisbane, on the Gold Coast, Southeast Queensland or Northern NSW.
Keith and the team at Energy Solutions Centre were absolute professionals, patient and thorough. Great customer service. Highly recommend!

I was in a bit of a bind when I came across Energy Solution Centre (ESC) to perform a solar panel/battery installation.  I had applied for the Queensland Battery Rebate Program with a supplier.  Unfortunately, after two months of promises the supplier still failed to meet some of the mandatory requirements of the program.  Searching for an alternate supplier, with the clock ticking on the rebate program, I found ESC.  I'm glad I did.They responded quickly (far better than the other companies I contacted).  Their system included state of the art solar panels, which were superior to my previous quote.  ESC uncovered the fact that I had dual phase power, which meant that I wouldn't get the full benefit of the solar/batter install.  This discovery allowed me to easily fix it by converting my house to single phase power.There were some ups and downs with the configuration process, but all resolved rapidly and satisfactorily. They even added a couple of bollards to the project to protect the battery.I'm happy to recommend Energy Solution Centre for Solar/battery installations in the Brisbane or Gold Coast areas.  The system is working a treat.

Working with Lucio and his team has been fantastic from the start. He spent the time to educate us about the solar market and answered the plethora of questions we had. No hard sell, competitive pricing and always prompt responses. After a lot of research, consideration and looking at alternatives, we decided to go with energy solution centre and their recommended new Aiko s2 panels. From signing the contract to panels on the roof was within 1 week. The install team was friendly, polite and efficient (all done within 6.5hrs). Appreciate the extra mile Lucio and crew took to get us the right product for our needs.

Added Battery Backup to our existing Solar System.Lucio and his team have been around a LONGTIME and this was the deciding factor in our choice to proceed.We could not be happier in the system and service we received from Lucio; we would highly recommend to anyone!

From day one, Keith patiently answered all our questions in great detail, providing prompt and accurate responses. He even took calls and conducted visits after hours, accommodating our schedule. The entire team at ESC has been fantastic and knowledgeable throughout the process, making us feel comfortable as we ventured into unknown territory. We highly recommend ESC if you're considering solar.
The sale & installation experience was very good, no problems at all

My Energy Solution Centre (ESC) sales representative was consistently patient in listening to our needs and explaining matters when asked or when we clearly didn't have the knowledge.  He was also very patient in responding to changing quote requests as our understanding increased.  Agreement to a mutually convenient install date and the coordination of the installation itself was smooth and instilled confidence.The installers themselves performed the installation professionally and efficiently.  Everything from roof-top panels to switchboard to inverter/battery system looks neat and professionally installed.Questions were welcomed and they were patient when we changed our minds in regard to which circuits would be on battery backup.  Since installation, we had several queries and requests for assistance, all of which were dealt with in a friendly manner and quickly.  So far, we have nothing but high praise for Energy Solution Centre.

Great from the start. They provided a very detailed and informative explanation of how it all works, and they customised solutions and gave us options tailored for what we actually needed. All was discussed, actioned and finalised in less than 3 weeks. The installers also did an excellent job with minimal disruption and fantastic manners.I highly recommend Lucio and his team

The Energy Solution Centre is bloody amazing. I can’t recommend them highly enough. Lucio, Keith and their team of amazing technicians are the best solar & battery experts in South East Queensland. Lucio took the time to sit down with us and understand what we were after from a battery perspective, as well as our Telsa vehicle charging needs. He provided some great options and a clear path to increase capacity over the next few years. If you’re reading this, don’t go any further looking for alternate providers, just reach out to Lucio – you won't regret it and you’ll get the best equipment available and the best service.

We are extremely happy with the service provided by Energy Solution Centre. Keith patiently answered all our questions and even contacted Energex for us before providing a great solar system taking in our budget and needs. Then Nathan did an exceptional job installing our system in a particularly horrendous heatwave.  We highly recommend this company.
Sales and quoting friendly and competitive. Installers were punctual, competent, clean and tidy. Followup service to activate Tesla App and monitor function was exceptional.

I recently had a 22KW Hybrid solar panel system installed at my premises. My experience with Lucio and the team at Energy Solution Centre throughout the whole process has been amazing.Lucio took the time to explain all options in detail to make sure I understood exactly what I was getting before a decision was made.The installers were on site within 4 weeks and had the system up and running in two days. Very professional outfit that I would recommend to anyone in the market for a solar system.

We cannot recommend this company highly enough. Wish I could rate them 10 stars. From our first consultation to the final installation the experience could not have been better. Ours was a complicated situation with lots of trees - we had previously been told it would not be impossible to instal solar.  Every difficulty was overcome by them and explained clearly to us. The instal was done very quickly and our site was left mess free. Very happy with the final product and would definitely recommend to anyone considering solar!

Lucio and Kevin (Energy Solution Centre) have been amazing. We wanted to upgrade our solar energy to provide the opportunity to be grid-free. Their software allowed us to view various options. We opted for Trina panels, Sungrow inverters and Tesla batteries. We live on the beach with a harsh environment so opted for a simple set-up. ESC managed to install a large number of panels so we have achieved our desire of potential self-sufficiency. The Tesla batteries are not intrusive. The whole process has been smooth and the after sales service continues. We are extremely satisfied with everything and would recommend ESC to anyone considering a solar system.

A massive thankyou to Lucio, Keith, Keenan and the entire team at Energy Solution Centre.We installed a large Goodwe battery solar system and we are super impressed. Lucio & Keith provided us with multiple options to suit our situation and made adjustments to ensure we got the best system at the right price.The system was neatly installed by Keenan and team who conducted themselves very professionally and did an amazing job.We are looking forward to never seeing another electricity bill!Mark & Sally

I was impressed with the service from start to finish. Lucio took the time to understand exactly what was required, provide several options and clearly explain everything in detail. Also, the post sales service of monitoring the performance of the system goes beyond expectations. Highly recommended.

The quoting process was easy+good-in the showroom-Keith show you everything-you can see all the different System-Option and explained. the installation was tidy-Punctual. Very good customer service helpful in the grid connection, fix and let me now i have broken tiles on the Roof.I recommend Energy Solution Centre as a very good Solar installer.

Exceptional service from the whole team. We had our sales consultant Lucio provide us with multiple options before proceeding with the best one that suited our budget and roof. We were installed a 12.95Kw Fronius system and it has saved us hundreds of dollars already... this last quarter bill same period last year was $780.00 (2020) this year $79.00 (2021). Just amazing can't thank the team enough & especially Lucio....

I’m very very happy that I engaged Energy Solution Centre to supply and install my solar system. Keith, Lucio and their whole team were a pleasure to deal with, their work standards and ethics were highly experienced, honest and reliable. Everything you need from a business. Plus very humorous on top. They provided excellent service and their after care service was amazing too when I ran into some self - inflicted issues ;) after setting an adapter on fire by accident and the whole system blew.No issues with energy solution centre as they managed all my problems and sorted everything for me ! That is service that goes above and beyond ! All promises kept. 100% happy customer

Was waiting for my car to get service and saw the Energy Solution Centre with the intention of getting a quote.I found Kieth very informative on my enquires, also met Lucio who reinforced information supplied by Kieth.As a result we went ahead with the quote, we are extremely happy with our SolarEdge system. The job was done extremely efficiently and after sales service with Josh was also exceptional.We would highly recommend these guys. Awesome experience.Geoff and Sylvia

We're extremely happy with our system upgrade. Keith was really helpful and available, both before and after the installation. This company is very interested in their customers maximising their solar, would highly recommend.

Wow, what an Experience!!!!From the get go, Lucio, Josh, Keith and the Energy Solutions Team were absolutely sensational!Collectively, they streamlined and packaged a system which is personalised, suited to my family and financial needs.If you want to cut out the crap and make your life easier by eliminating the telesales people, but really want to understand the value of the importance of Solar systems, don't delay  head to these guys, they will look after you... no regrets whatsoever, they will not disappoint!

We are happy to refer the Energy Solution Centre to anyone undertaking a solar battery decision for their particular circumstances. As we were pleased with Lucio and his fluent knowledge to have all the options made available to us to choose the most cost effective system, to the range of capability that we were wanting to achieve with our solar battery off grid set up. Great guys getting the system quickly up and operating. Now with my off grid solar system, not concerned with the rising power costs.Regards Sue and Leigh.

Great experience from the start with sales which probably got them over the line against the other quotes.Installation date was impressive with the installers turning up on time and finishing in just over half a day on ahigh set house. The guys were very polite, courteous & tidy, patiently taking us through the system and helping set upthe app to follow our daily usage.Sales stayed involved in the process throughout calling to keep us updated and was on site for the install to answer any questions and introduce the team.

My encounter and transaction with Energy Solution Centre was excellent. Really friendly people, very keen to help. My needs were a bit technical, but they were really knowledgeable and spot on with solutions. I got exactly what I wanted, in a timely manner, and was kept up-to-date with plenty of progress reports and contacts.The installer was truly an expert — careful, thorough, quick, chatty and friendly. The job was an upgrade of a system that had been installed by another company, and he ‘tuned’ my system to make it work better, as should have been done at initial installation.I cannot recommend a solar supplier/installer more highly!
Great customer service. Prompt and efficient installation. Would definitely recommend

We had a 7.8kw system installed recently. ESC went above and beyond with a shade assessment and strategic placement of the panels, which I found to be quite favorable compared to the quotes provided by others who didn't bother to check for impact by trees and the roof orientation in both summer and winter. Keith provided great advice and choice of various panels and inverters, pros and cons of each, and set realistic expectations. Installation was professional and very prompt. The longest wait was for Energex to upgrade my meter!

Never thought getting Solar would be so easy! Massive thanks to the team at Energy Solution Centre in Nerang. Cheers to Lucio for making everything so seamless and for always keeping in touch with the progress. Loved the initial communication and quote format, was very impressed. Thanks to Kevin and the team for the quality install of my 10.79kW System with a Fronius inverter and Trina panels. Very impressed and can’t wait to use it! (Waiting on slow retailer for meter change)Would recommend to anyone looking for a great solar install! Cheers guys

Amazing install experience and excellent after service support from Lucio and his team.  Found them directly from Redback as solar quotes couldn't find an installer for the configuration I wanted.After a month I am amazed at how well the system is installing and glad to have made the investment in a battery.  The Redback was the only system I found that could provide me with the capability to charge during grid outage and offer UPS like capabilities with 0.05 second cutover.

Long Review, please take the time to read if you want to know what it is like dealing with the Energy Solution Centre. I don’t often bother to take the time to write online reviews, but dealing with Lucio, Glen, Kevin, and the Energy Solution Centre team of installers was such a fantastic experience that have put words down to let people know, just how highly we recommend the Energy Solution Centre team for their knowledge, professionalism, after sales service and their care with our solar system.After buying our new home in the hinterland we experienced, three power blackouts in quick succession, due to storms in the Hinterland area. Energex providing a distinctly third world power supply made us look around for a renewable system with battery backup. We found Lucio and Glen at Energy Solution Centre and they provided sound advice, a very reasonable quote for what we eventually purchased and highly professional installation and after sales service.We purchased a 10kW solar array with Redback inverter to add to the existing 10kW rooftop array, plus a 14.2kWh Redback battery backup system. The system was installed and has pretty much run as reliably as a Swiss watch since the day it was commissioned. It has worked so well that we have just purchased another 14.2kWh battery as we found that after a week or so of non-stop rain, we were facing having a flat battery. That was, until Glen contacted us and ask if he could switch the battery over to grid recharge as the storms and rain were going to go on for several more days. (That is the kind of amazing after sales service you get from the guys at Energy Solution Centre)The Redback inverter and battery system is a great product, produced locally and supported locally, I dealt with the guys at Redback after, yet another storm fried our Telstra modem. The Redback team got the system back online in short order, almost immediately after Telstra replaced the cooked modem.The third world power supply by Energex hasn’t changed in our area, so during and after the recent terrible flooding storms in Southeast Queensland our area was blacked-out more often than it had power. But it was great to have everything just continue to be up and running and being able to offer warm food, cups of coffee and hot shows to our neighbours rather than just having to sit in the dark like they were doing.I know this review is long but here’s the bottom line that you also need to consider when thinking about getting a solar and hopefully battery system from the team at Energy Solution Centre. In our new home we also have a three-phase whole of house air conditioner system, that during the summer months was running pretty much non-stop. With the new Array and battery backup system our electricity bills went from paying $300 per month to getting $150-$200 from the electricity company we use. Yes, that is what I wrote, we are now getting paid by the electricity company $150-$200 each month.Thank you, Lucio, Glen, and the Team from Energy Solution Centre.If you’ve read this review, do yourself and the planet a real favour, get a solar and battery system from the team at the Energy Solution Centre.
The team did an excellent job installing solar cell system, and after 18 months I am still very pleased with the job.

ESC was the third company we had to provide us a price for Solar, they were by far the most knowledgeable and helpful, thoroughly explaining the different options available for panels and batteries. They were also the most cost effective. The install went well and the panels seem to be working efficiently.

Purchased 7.4 Kw system off Energy Solution Centre in Nerang, Qld.  The whole process was seamless, the project went / delivered on time and as promised. I was thoroughly guided through the process as well as asked many questions regarding the systems life and upgradable into the future.Professional installation process went smoothly and was walked through the systems start / stop operation process.Lucio & his team did a great job and am happy with the entire installation. Would have no hesitation in approaching them should I have a problem or issue with the system.Thank you Lucio & Keith for your professional assistance.

Sales process was better than expected; the sales person (Matthew) was customer focused and delivered beyond promise. He came on the day at the end of the installation and even swept around the battery! He's remained available for questions anytime thereafter, even when I message him out of hours!Very good installation team and that is key to me, they were knowledgeable and nice people with attention to details and leaving the place clean. All done in one day despite the early morning storm!Grid connection/relationship to utility was handled in the background, I didn't have to worry about anything.All done very well, I am telling my best friends about Energy Solution Centre.(I am just a customer, this is not planted :-) )
Mathew and the team at solar solutions were amazing through the whole process. Love the new system and the app is amazing, was even able to use the app on my fridge which is awesome. 100% recommend

ESC demonstrate the highest level of professionalism & client attention. They are knowledgeable and detailed in their explanations of the process and products. ESC care about their business, their clients and the environment. I highly recommend ESC to anyone seeking to improve their life by installing solar energy generation.
These guys now their stuff, very easy explanations, super fast turnaround times, exceptional installer
We found Energy Solution Centre able and willing to assist us with our solar transformation and now together we are working on becoming almost self sufficient living off solar

The staff of Energy Solutions Nerang were prompt with quotes and followup when my wife and I wanted a solar system last year. What made the choice to go with them was their attention to detail and a genuine interest in what we wanted. I think the solar market is very competitive so always give the edge to those who look after their customers. Lucio and Glen have our business and we would recommend them to anyone looking for solar.
Lucio and the team were fantastic to deal with, very knowledgeable, honest and friendly - couldn't be happier!
